originating_goal: Reduce the public GitHub implementation surface after StegVerse-SDK became the canonical public evaluator/proof aperture, while preserving only affirmative public contract/proof/publication surfaces.

claim.expiration_or_release_condition: Release when estate inventory is complete, every reachable repository is classified, all visibility writes available to the current connector are applied and verified, and unavailable writes are transferred to the TV/TVC-governed GitHub organization administration executor with an observable release condition.

conditions: inventory contains repository with state PENDING_HANDOFF_DEPENDENCY_REVIEW, PENDING_CONTRACT_REVIEW, PENDING_PUBLICATION_REVIEW, PENDING_IP_PUBLICATION_REVIEW, or PENDING_SANITIZATION_REVALIDATION
or an approved target visibility differs from live GitHub metadata

execution.phase_1_action: Enumerate reachable StegVerse repositories, read each newest applicable *_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md, resolve public dependency obligations, and update the canonical inventory deterministically.
execution.phase_2_action: For entries explicitly approved PRIVATE_REQUIRED whose live metadata is public, apply the repository visibility transition without exporting or introducing a non-TV/TVC credential.
execution.phase_3_action: Re-read live repository metadata, verify SDK/public-contract regression conditions, and persist a verification receipt for every attempted mutation.

deterministic_outputs: approved target visibility or explicit review/block state

duplicate_execution_prevention.rule: Only one active visibility mutation claim per repository. A mutation is not retryable while an unexpired claim or unresolved receipt exists.
duplicate_execution_prevention.stale_claim_rule: Expired claims must be released, renewed with new live evidence, or marked BLOCKED with a machine-observable release condition.

release_conditions.per_repository: live visibility equals approved target and verification receipt is committed, or the repository is explicitly retained public with a current affirmative public requirement
release_conditions.whole_goal: all reachable repositories classified; all approved mutations verified; public aperture regression passes; no visibility requirement remains only in chat

blocked_state.condition: current connected GitHub action set has no repository-visibility write action
blocked_state.observable_release: a StegVerse-authorized org-admin visibility executor becomes available or live metadata reflects an approved transition
blocked_state.next_action: continue classification and dependency review without guessing; apply only mutations for which authorized visibility-write capability exists

historical_disclosure_rule: Changing a repository from public to private does not retract prior clones, forks, caches, packages, releases or disclosed commit history. Persist that fact in each mutation receipt.
next_executable_action: Complete repository-local handoff/dependency review for CANDIDATE_PRIVATE entries, beginning with StegVerse-Labs/StegCore, then LLM-adapter, hybrid-collab-bridge, StegVerse-Healer and discovery; approve mutations only after public-contract sufficiency is verified.
